Lions vs Panthers DraftKings Showdown Picks: Sunday Night Football NFL DFS Captains, Projections and Sim Plays

DraftKings Showdown · Sunday Night Football, October 4 · NFL Week 4 · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 4, 8:15 AM ET

Jahmyr Gibbs has the highest SPAGS projection in the Lions at Panthers DraftKings Showdown: 26.3 points at $12,000 FLEX, 39.5 at captain for $18,000. Across 10,000 simulations Gibbs holds 74% of the winning-lineup credit.

He also has the largest captain share: 28.6% of the simulated winning-lineup credit comes with Gibbs at captain. Amon-Ra St. Brown is the next captain in line, at 10.3%. The model gives him 10.5 targets on 31.8 routes.

Detroit is a 3.5-point favorite, and the implied totals are 27.5 for the Lions and 24 for the Panthers.

Behind Gibbs and Brown, the next projections are Jared Goff (18.4, $10,000), Bryce Young (18.0, $9,800) and Chuba Hubbard (16.0, $9,400).

Every projection below is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 4, 8:15 AM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. Winning-lineup and captain credit come from 10,000 simulations of the Showdown contest, and tied winning entries share credit. A player's simulated floor is his 10th-percentile score and his ceiling is his 95th. Showdown lineups use one captain, who scores 1.5x at 1.5x salary, and five FLEX players.

Chris Spags' latest NFL DFS breakdown on the Splash Play NFL channel.

SNF Showdown captain picks: who the sim wins with

Captain: Jahmyr Gibbs, DET RB ($12,000 FLEX / $18,000 CPT)

Jahmyr Gibbs holds 28.6% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain, more than any other player in this game. At captain he costs $18,000 and the 26.3-point SPAGS model projection becomes 39.5 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 22.9 carries and 5.7 targets. Across 10,000 simulations Gibbs averaged 26.3 points with a simulated floor of 14.1 and a ceiling of 41.6. He holds 74% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 28.6% as the captain and 45.7% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Amon-Ra St. Brown, DET WR ($11,000 FLEX / $16,500 CPT)

Amon-Ra St. Brown holds 10.3% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $16,500 and the 18.9-point SPAGS model projection becomes 28.3 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 10.5 targets on 31.8 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Brown averaged 18.7 points with a simulated floor of 7.2 and a ceiling of 37.0. He holds 42% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 10.3% as the captain and 31.4% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Jalen Coker, CAR WR ($7,400 FLEX / $11,100 CPT)

Jalen Coker holds 10.1% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $11,100 and the 13.9-point SPAGS model projection becomes 20.9 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 7.2 targets on 29.4 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Coker averaged 13.9 points with a simulated floor of 3.4 and a ceiling of 34.4. He holds 36% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 10.1% as the captain and 25.9% in a FLEX spot.

Jared Goff, DET QB ($10,000 FLEX / $15,000 CPT)

Across 10,000 simulations Wright averaged 4.4 points with a simulated floor of 0.0 and a ceiling of 12.3. He holds 16% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 0.5% as the captain and 15.6% in a FLEX spot.

Across 10,000 simulations Tremble averaged 5.7 points with a simulated floor of 0.0 and a ceiling of 15.2. Lions vs Panthers DraftKings Showdown FAQ

Who is the best captain for the Lions vs Panthers DraftKings Showdown?

Jahmyr Gibbs holds the largest captain share of simulated winning lineups at 28.6%, ahead of Amon-Ra St. Brown (10.3%) and Jalen Coker (10.1%), across 10,000 simulations.

What is the best DraftKings Showdown lineup for Lions vs Panthers?

Build around Amon-Ra St. Brown at captain with Jahmyr Gibbs, Jared Goff and Jake Bates at FLEX. That is the core of the lineup that won the most simulations in Chris Spags' pool (15 of 10,000 simulated contests), and it leaves $6,500 for the last two FLEX spots.

Who has the highest projection in Lions vs Panthers DraftKings Showdown?

Jahmyr Gibbs leads the SPAGS model at 26.3 DraftKings points for $12,000 at FLEX, or 39.5 points at captain for $18,000.

What are the DraftKings salaries for Lions vs Panthers Showdown?

Jahmyr Gibbs is the most expensive player at $12,000 FLEX and $18,000 at captain. All 30 players with a SPAGS projection are listed above with FLEX salary, captain salary and projection.

What are the best value plays in Lions vs Panthers DraftKings Showdown?

At $5,000 and under, the best projected points per $1,000 belong to Brock Wright (4.4 points at $1,600), Tommy Tremble (5.8 points at $2,400) and Darren Waller (9.2 points at $4,400).

What is the Lions vs Panthers spread and total?

The Lions are a 3.5-point favorite in a game totaled at 51.5, with implied team totals of 27.5 for the Lions and 24 for the Panthers.
